chunks: ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام about a man who performs sajdah on a misḥ and a carpet, so he said:
"There is no issue if it is in a state of taqiyyah."

key_terms.التَّقِيَّةِ: precautionary dissimulation for protection in circumstances of risk
key_terms.الْمِسْحِ: a coarse mat or woven covering used on the ground
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or blame

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform sajdah on a carpet during taqiyyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning sajdah on a mat or carpet. The Imam عليه السلام permits it specifically in a situation of taqiyyah, indicating a concession when protection or precaution requires outward conformity.
